messages:
maya: Quick triage — EU hourly aggregates from 2025-03-01 00:00 -> 2025-03-02 06:00 are ~12% low vs expected. Patterns match late-event arrivals + a handful of stuck shard replays. Anyone else seeing this?
aj: saw the spike on dashboard at 07:12 UTC, digging into consumer lag now. :mag:
ops-bot: [alert] replay-queue-eu shard-delay > 45m (shard_ids: 1132, 1137)
lin: 1132 was stuck on a tenant that hit dedupe-id conflict yesterday, we force-removed and it appeared to unstick briefly. suspect partial handoff left gaps.
samir: the replayer marks progress via checkpoint_id; if a handoff failed we may have left a hole between checkpoints. need to claim and re-run those shards in order.
maya: can we claim shards without a full backfill? prefer targeted recompute for those hours. Console UX doesn’t expose shard claim right now.
devex: agree — the console has a “replay job” flow but not a single-shard claim button. we could add a temp operator action in the ops panel.
aj: for immediate fix I can run a targeted replay job for the 2-hour window, but we need to ensure idempotency and dedupe tokens are honored.
lin: important: use the replay service's safe-claim mode: it validates checkpoint continuity before applying. sample command:
```
# safe-claim shard 1132 and run window
curl -X POST https://replay.internal/v1/claim -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' -d '{"shard":1132,"from":"2025-03-01T00:00:00Z","to":"2025-03-01T06:00:00Z","mode":"safe"}'
```
samir: two notes — 1) include `allow-overlap=false` so we don't double-apply. 2) patch the replayer to emit a `rehydrate-snap` event so console can surface snapshot age.
maya: @aj can you run the safe-claim for 1132 with overlap off and post logs here? I'll hold the canary and check the aggregates after completion.
aj: running now. logging to /mnt/logs/replay/claim-1132-4743219876.log — will paste tail.
deploy-bot: deploy started: replay-service v2.14.1 -> canary on eu-1 (id dpl-774).
aj: tail: 
```
INFO claim started shard=1132 window=2025-03-01T00:00:00Z..2025-03-01T06:00:00Z mode=safe allow-overlap=false
INFO checkpoint validated prev=7692 next=7704
WARN  missing-chunk tenant=blueco ltd chunk_idx=5
INFO rehydrating snapshot from s3://redwood-replay-snapshots/eu/1132/7703.snap
INFO replayed 12.4k events, deduped 200
INFO claim complete status=ok duration=87s
```
maya: :thumbsup: looking at console metrics — aggregate counts for that window increased, gap narrowed to ~0.8%.
lin: likely remaining gap is shard 1137. I'll prepare claim but want to coordinate quota so we don't blow replay throughput for other tenants.
aj: can we set a per-tenant throttle? replay-service supports `max_inflight` and `token_bucket` per namespace. propose `max_inflight=3` for targeted backfills.
samir: also add a short-lived priority lane so operator jobs don't get preempted by normal scheduled replays. we already have priority tags, but need a UI toggle so non-ops folks can't accidentally enable.
devex: for the console change: show snapshot age, a red warning when snapshot > 24h, and a small "Claim shard" button in ops panel (only visible to users with `replay:claim` permission). Also add a confirmation modal with the command summary.
maya: can we ship the UI patch as a feature flag and enable it for ops then flip to prod when stable?
devex: yeah — FF `replay_claim_ops_v1`. I'll open a tiny PR and link here.
aj: filing runbook note in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/notes/4743219876 — includes command snippet and checklist.
lin: scheduling claim for 1137 in 20m, using same safe-mode + overlap=false + max_inflight=3. I'll coordinate with infra to reserve 2 extra GPUs for the window.
ops-bot: [note] reserved extra replay capacity for 30m starting 2025-03-01T08:00:00Z
maya: once both shards done, we'll run a recompute-agg-job against the materialized aggregates and validate daily dashboards. If everything within 0.5% then close.
samir: follow-up action items: [lin] run claim 1137 + post logs, [devex] PR + FF, [aj] update runbook and add dedupe checklist, [maya] validate aggregates and close.
maya: thanks all — short-term priority. We'll use this to iterate on console UX and add snapshot-age telemetry to avoid surprises. :eyes:
